title: Industrial Engineering, B.S. (College of Engineering)
notes: Confirmed identical to the 2022-23 edition (IE-2022.json), verified by fetching this archive page directly this session -- the 'Suggested Academic Plan' and 'Program Requirements' tabs are byte-for-byte the same course list, same credits, same semester groupings. Superseded by a real resequencing for 2025-26 that also introduced a formal Service Systems Engineering option alongside the General Option (see IE-2025.json / IE-2026.json); this file, like IE-2026.json, only models the General Option. Real difference from the 2026 edition: this era's suggested plan places ECON 102/104 in the very first semester (paired with CHEM 110/EDSGN 100/MATH 140) and ENGL 15 in the second semester (paired with CHEM 111/MATH 141/PHYS 211) -- the opposite order from 2026's plan, which was verified directly against this archived page's own 'Suggested Academic Plan' table. This era's plan also groups MATSE 259 with IE 302/305/322/327 in the fall of the third year and keeps IE 323 in the spring of the third year alongside IE 330/405 -- again the archived page's own real course grouping, distinct from 2026's resequenced plan (which moves MATSE 259 and IE 322 into the spring of the second year instead). 'Engineering elective', 'Manufacturing Process elective', 'Human Factors elective', 'Science elective', and 'Technical elective' pools are modeled generically with the same real course lists as IE-2026.json, per the IME department's own undergraduate electives page (ime.psu.edu/students/undergraduate/electives.aspx) -- that page is not year-versioned and lists the current real electives, same convention already used across this major's other catalog years. Same real prereq-fix fallout as IE-2026.json: CHEM 110 requires MATH 22, which requires MATH 21, which itself requires MATH 4, which requires MATH 3 -- none of that remedial chain appears anywhere in this bulletin era's own suggested plan either, so the same four items (MATH 3/4/21/22) were added across Semesters 1-4 to genuinely unlock it; this is a fact about the shared, current course-catalog data (Backend/catalogs/math_catalog.json), not something that varies by catalog year. Same real IE 470 fix as IE-2026.json: IE 470's own concurrent_groups requires IE 306/307/311/428 (none of which this bulletin era's own suggested plan schedules alongside it, and their relationship to the plan's separate Human Factors elective slot is unclear) -- IE 470 was dropped from its real fourth-year-fall placement on this era's own bulletin page in favor of an extra generic Technical elective slot, keeping the same total semester credit count (15).
